This was the first charger I've ever taken apart, and it was certainly an educational experience. It's still hard to grasp how far Anker has pushed charger tech to the point where we're at today. Fitting 160W in a brick nearly as small as an AirPod Pro case would be unthinkable a few years ago. Huge props to them for consistently pushing this industry to where it is.
